data.name: Hizaana
data.gender_notes: Hizaana is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hizaana is derived from the Arabic word 'hizan', which means 'to be graceful' or 'to move with grace'. The name Hizaana carries the meaning “Graceful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Hizaana usually hope their child will grow to embody graceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Hizaana is a reminder to carry oneself with grace and poise, reflecting the inner peace and strength of one's faith.
data.etymology: Hizaana belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Graceful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hizaana total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: حزانة
in_arabic.meaning: حفظ و نگهداری ، امانت ، حفاظت شده
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم حزانة مشتق من الجذر ح-ز-ن و يعني الحفظ و النجاسة و الامانت و الشيء المحفوظ ، و يدل علي معاني الرفع و الحفاظ و التكريم و في القرآن الكريم لم يرد ذكر هذا الاسم صراحةً و لكن الجذر يستخدم في عدة مواضع مثل الحفظ و الحزانة لله تعالي

in_urdu.name: حزانہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: اسم حزانہ عربی جڑ ح-ز-ن سے ماخوذ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے حفاظت کرنا ، امانت اور محفوظ شدہ چیز ، یہ نام جنوب ایشیائی مسلمانوں کے درمیان میں مقبول ہے اور اس کا تعلق محفوظ شدہ اور حفاظت کے مفاہم سے ہے

in_hindi.name: हिज़ाना

in_english.name: Hizaana
in_english.long_meaning: The name Hizaana originates from the Arabic root ح-ز-ن (ḥ-z-n), which conveys meanings of protection, preservation, and trust. While not directly mentioned in the Quran, the root is utilized in various contexts related to safeguarding and trust. Historically, the name has been used across Muslim cultures, symbolizing the values of safety, reliability, and spiritual guardianship

data.cultural_impact: The name Hizaana may suggest an air of sophistication, elegance, and gracefulness. In many Islamic cultures, names are highly valued and chosen with great care, reflecting the values and characteristics that parents hope their children will embody. A name like Hizaana may encourage its bearer to move with poise and confidence, leaving a positive impression on those around them.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic spiritual context, the name Hizaana may be seen as a reminder to move through life with the beauty, grace, and dignity bestowed upon us by God. It may serve as a reminder to be mindful of our actions and words, and to treat ourselves and others with compassion and respect. Ultimately, the name Hizaana encourages us to reflect the divine attributes of grace and elegance in our daily lives.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Hizaana: Embodiment of patience and resilience, carrying the weight of life's trials with grace and dignity, steadfast in faith.
